# tsuga_monitor_folder (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Top-level monitor folder
resource "tsuga_monitor_folder" "platform" {
  name  = "Platform"
  owner = "abc-123-def"
  tags = [
    {
      key   = "team"
      value = "platform"
    }
  ]
}

# Folders nest one level deep: a child folder points at a top-level folder
resource "tsuga_monitor_folder" "platform-ingestion" {
  name             = "Ingestion"
  owner            = "abc-123-def"
  parent_folder_id = tsuga_monitor_folder.platform.id
}

# Monitors join a folder through their own folder_id
resource "tsuga_monitor" "ingestion-no-logs" {
  name        = "No ingestion logs"
  owner       = "abc-123-def"
  permissions = "all"
  priority    = 2
  folder_id   = tsuga_monitor_folder.platform-ingestion.id
  configuration = {
    log = {
      queries = [
        {
          filter = "service:ingestion"
          aggregate = {
            count = {}
          }
        }
      ]
      conditions = [{
        formula   = "q1"
        operator  = "equal"
        threshold = 0
      }]
      timeframe               = 10
      group_by_fields         = []
      no_data_behavior        = "alert"
      aggregation_alert_logic = "no_aggregation"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the monitor folder.
- `owner` (String) ID of the team that owns the monitor folder and controls folder access.

### Optional

- `parent_folder_id` (String) ID of the top-level parent folder when this folder is nested. Set by the caller on create or update. Returned only for child folders; omitted for top-level folders.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Key/value tags to apply to the resource. Tag policies may require specific keys or values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tsuga-generated monitor folder ID assigned when the folder is created. Use it as monitor `folderId` or child-folder `parentFolderId`.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Required:

- `key` (String) Tag key to attach to the resource.
- `value` (String) Tag value to attach to the resource. Leading or trailing whitespace is rejected.
